details: CONSUMER AFFAIRS, FOOD AND PUBLIC DISTRIBUTION

(c) & (d): NITI Aayog has constituted a Core Committee to monitor the impact evaluation of
the Rice Fortification Initiative. NITI Aayog and Indian Council of Medical Research- National Institute of Nutrition (ICMR-NIN) have taken up study in six districts in six different states of the country to evaluate the impacts of iron fortified rice supplied through the Public Distribution Systems in India.

records.title: Tap connection under Jal Jeevan Mission in Chhattisgarh
details:
As reported by the Government of Chhattisgarh on Integrated Management Information System
(IMIS) of the Department as on 16.07.2024, 50,05,219 households are targeted for providing tap
connections in the State of Chhattisgarh and 39,23,716 households are provided with tap
connections till date.
10,81,503 households in all including in Baster and Kanker districts are still to be provided tap
connections in State of Chhattisgarh as per data available on JJM IMIS Dashboard as on
16.07.2024 for which works are ongoing. The state government expects to complete the works
by March 2026.

records.title: Development of Indigenous rare earth Minerals
details: The Govt. is actively working on capacity building for consumption of the RE within the Country. As regards lab-to-product ecosystem, a Rare Earth Theme Park is being setup which will upscale the scientific principles proven at laboratory to pilot scale and demonstrate the same to aspiring Industries willing to set up commercial operations.
